note: Missouri River bottomland wetlands below Grand Pass, with waterfowl pools and six miles of river frontage. The map marks three primitive camping spots along the south boundary road: this pin is the west one, at the gravel lot where the levee roads meet near the river; another is at the headquarters lot on Route N, and a third is a roadside spot east of Gazebo Avenue. Boat-in camping is also allowed along the river. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites; Boat-in along Missouri River'; Rule 140 standard (no permit rule); map (5/3/2023) three Primitive Camping symbols = GIS 167-169. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. PIN (GIS 167) in trees ~35 m E of gravel lot 1407: move onto the lot 39.27139,-93.32851. No split. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Individual Campsites; Boat-in along Missouri River'; Rule 140 is the standard text ('Camping is allowed only as designated in the "Things To Do When You Visit" section ... Designated camping areas may or may not have defined campsites'), no special-use-permit rule. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map.' Map (5/3/2023) legend 'Primitive Camping'; three symbols: at Parking Lot 1 (SW, = GIS 167), at the headquarters lot on Route N (= GIS 168), and on the south boundary road east of Gazebo Ave near the observation tower (= GIS 169). Imagery: lot 1407 is a gravel lot ~35 x 40 m at the junction of the levee roads, a 23-ft rig fits easily; lot 1410 at the headquarters is a gravel lot ~45 x 25 m beside Route N. Not boat-ramp lots (the ramps are at lots 2, 3, 4 and on the pools). Designated points at lots: stays. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.

GIS 169 (39.27751,-93.28421): imagery shows only a crop-field edge by a fence-line of brush ~40 m north of the gravel county road; no pull-off or pad is visible, so that third spot is padless roadside at best (it is not the pinned camp).
PIN: stored 39.27133,-93.32809 = GIS 167, in the trees ~35 m east of gravel lot 1407. Move onto the lot: 39.27139,-93.32851.

CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: 167 (pin, west lot) and 168 (headquarters lot, 1.2 km east) share the same boundary road from Route N; 169 is 3.8 km east on the county road past Gazebo Ave, with no lot visible, so no split is proposed. near.py: Annie and Abel Van Meter State Park (1857) is 2.0 km from 169; nothing else within 3 km.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the Missouri River is ~150 m SW of lot 1407 behind a wooded bank and field; no view from the lot.

SEASON: the map's waterfowl refuges close 'to all uses from Oct. 15 through Mar. 1'; the three camps sit outside the hatched refuge zones on the boundary road. Season (manual, year-round with the waterfowl note) left as stored.
Note rewritten: acreage, generic MDC text, the 14-day limit (now booking.max_stay_nights), 'site length not published' and directions dropped; the three camps and boat-in camping put in.
